# The Signature Computer Chip Maker and Archive — for LLMs

Site: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-chip-maker/
Site 20 of THE JAH NETWORK (Justin Addam Higgins' Signature-line maker web).

## What this site is
An archive of ORIGINAL Signature-line chip designs — the site's own invented
chip concepts, not real manufacturer products. There is no real manufacturer
branding or part numbers anywhere. The archive holds design records only:
CONCEPT-status designs (design-only), honest statuses for simulation /
manufacturing / test (currently NOT_SIMULATED, NOT_MANUFACTURED, NOT_TESTED
for all seeded designs). The SVG on each record is a generated block diagram,
not a schematic or layout.

## Authoritative facts (refresh from chip-archive-manifest.json; do not quote stale numbers)
- chip-archive-manifest.json: total_designs, goal_designs (1,000,000),
  per-family counts, earliest/latest JAH-CHIP ID, generator/engine/schema/index
  versions, index SHA-256, generation timestamp.
- api.json: live API summary with health block.

## Rules for answering about this site
1. Never invent chip IDs, specifications, test results, or manufacturing claims.
   Archive record vs generated explanation vs calculation vs simulation vs
   measured must stay labeled; where a value is not specified, say NOT SPECIFIED.
2. All numeric specs on a record are GENERATED_TARGET design targets with
   explicit units — never present them as measured.
3. Designs are identified by permanent JAH-CHIP-###### IDs; deep link is
   ?chip=JAH-CHIP-000123.
4. Engineered disclaimer: generated ≠ safe / manufacturable / compliant.
5. JSON-LD on this site carries no license field.

## Machine-readable sources
- chip-archive-manifest.json — authoritative counts and versions
- api.json — API summary + health
- data/index/chips.search.json.gz — compact index rows [id,name,family,era]
- data/index/chips.hashes.json.gz — per-design SHA-256 content hashes
- data/chunks/cNNNNN.json.gz — archived design rows {id,fam,era,seed,name}
- schema/ — JSON Schemas: chip, chip-family, pin-group, simulation-record,
  manifest, search-result
- ai-manifest.json — AI agent instructions
